choices: Several times over a few days

questions.prompt: Have you ever been told you have a stomach ulcer or swollen veins in the food pipe (varices)?
Has your weight changed recently?

questions.prompt: Was the blood coughed up from the chest, or brought up with vomiting from the stomach?
choices: Came up without clear cough or vomit

questions.prompt: What did the material look like when it came up?
choices: Mixed blood with food or fluid
Frothy / mixed with sputum (possibly from chest)

questions.prompt: About how much bloody material came up (best estimate)?

Is the stool sticky and tar-like, or only dark without being sticky?
choices: Not sure / did not look closely

questions.prompt: Where is the blood relative to the stool?
choices: On the surface of the stool
Only on toilet paper / dripping into the bowl

questions.prompt: What colour is the blood from the rectum?
